name: How do I know if I need a full interior remodel or a home addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a full interior remodel or a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a full interior remodel and a home addition depends on whether your existing footprint meets your total square-footage needs. A full remodel reconfigures interior walls, repurposes unused areas, and modernizes rooms without expanding the home's exterior shell. However, if your family requires additional bedrooms, an expanded main suite, or a larger kitchen that interior walls cannot accommodate, an addition provides essential extra square footage. Home additions involve new foundation and framing work, representing higher exterior structural work compared to interior-focused renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a remodel if your existing square footage can be reconfigured; choose an addition if your lot allows and you need new interior space beyond current exterior walls.
